name: Mahjong
summary: Four-player tile set-collection game where players draw and discard to form chows, pongs, kongs and a pair.
rules_text: Players build a two-high wall of shuffled suit tiles (1-9 Bamboo, Characters, Dots), winds, dragons and optional flowers/seasons. Each gets a personal wind; East is dealer. Deal 13 tiles to each, 14 to dealer. Flowers/seasons are revealed immediately and replaced from the Kong Box. Dealer discards one tile, naming it. Play proceeds right to left. On your turn draw the next wall tile or claim the last discard if it completes a set: chows only from player ahead on your turn, pongs/kongs/mahjong from anyone, with mahjong taking precedence. Claimed sets are melded face-up. Keep 13 tiles. Objective is four sets (chow=run of 3 same suit, pong=3 identical, kong=4 identical which requires an extra draw from the Kong Box) plus an identical pair. First to complete this hand declares Mahjong and ends the hand immediately, then scores based on concealed vs melded sets, major tiles, winds, dragons and bonuses.
rating_reason: Hidden tile sets, strategic melds, fits hidden_hands arithmetic
